analysis.scope: Independent naturally barrel-conditioned legal draft families with full adopted terrain-aware v11 combat and real paid public native Setup. Different host families cannot identify a hardware strength effect. Independent confirmation does not automatically promote or deploy; separate preselected v11 real-clock cost must also pass.

sources.text:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,gzip,hashlib,json,collections
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;rawreg=(p/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(rawreg);seal=hashlib.sha256(rawreg).hexdigest()
for f in reg['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((p/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']
statuses={h:json.loads((p/f'confirmation-{h}/status.json').read_text())for h in ['local','puffalo']}
assert all(s['complete']and not s['errors']and not s['liveWorkerPids']for s in statuses.values())
assert sum(s['fights']for s in statuses.values())==18144
cases={(j['board'],j['game']):j for j in json.loads((p/'cases.json').read_text())};cov={j['board']:j for j in json.loads((p/'strength-family-covariates.json').read_text())}
pairs={};rawsha={};count=0;mixture_roots=accepted_calls=0
for host in ['local','puffalo']:
 for f in sorted((p/f'confirmation-{host}').glob('worker-*.jsonl.gz')):
  raw=f.read_bytes();rawsha[f.relative_to(p).as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
  for line in gzip.decompress(raw).splitlines():
   r=json.loads(line);key=(r['board'],r['game']);j=cases[key];assert r['registrationSha256']==seal and r['assignedHost']==host==cov[r['board']]['host'];assert r['seed']==j['seed']and r['inputSha256']==j['expectedInputSha256']
   team=2 if(r['game']<2)==(r['game']%2==0)else 1;assert r['team']==team
   assert r['winner']in ['green','red','draw'];assert r['score']==(.5 if r['winner']=='draw'else int(r['winner']==('green'if team==2 else'red')))
   assert r['quality']['rejected']==0 and r['quality']['neural']and r['quality']['work'];assert r['decisionMicros']and r['actualTurns']
   for n in r['quality']['neural']:assert n['modelErrors']==n['missingStart']==0
   for w in r['quality']['work']:assert all(w.get(k,0)==0 for k in ['deadlineFallbacks','circuitSkipped','circuitWaitArbitrations','degradedDecisions'])
   if r['mode']=='mixture':assert r['mixtureRoots']>0;mixture_roots+=r['mixtureRoots']
   if r['mode']=='accepted':assert r['acceptedModelCalls']>0;accepted_calls+=r['acceptedModelCalls'];assert r['acceptedPairSha256']=='675b438406b6ee3aa313feb1e382843a0442bc9970bc28810abc19d30d26aa68'
   pair=pairs.setdefault(key,{});assert r['mode']not in pair
   pair[r['mode']]={'inputSha256':r['inputSha256'],'traceSha256':r['traceSha256'],'score':r['score'],'winner':r['winner'],'actualTurnsSha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r['actualTurns'],separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()};count+=1
assert len(pairs)==6048 and count==18144 and set(pairs)==set(cases)
assert all(set(v)=={'stock','mixture','accepted'}for v in pairs.values())
trace_index=[{'board':board,'game':game,'arms':pair}for(board,game),pair in sorted(pairs.items())]
with(p/'complete-trace-index.json.gz').open('xb')as f:f.write(gzip.compress((json.dumps(trace_index,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode(),compresslevel=1,mtime=0))
result={'passed':True,'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'families':1512,'cases':6048,'fights':18144,'allFrozenSourceAndInputIdentitiesExact':True,'allAuthoritativeNeuralAndTimingControlsValid':True,'mixtureRoots':mixture_roots,'acceptedReferenceCalls':accepted_calls,'registrationSha256':seal,'rawSha256':rawsha,'aggregateScoresInspected':False}
with(p/'preaggregate-quality-audit.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='rawSha256'}),flush=True)

costBoundary.bothContinueUnchanged: Both registered fixed cost checks remain pending. Passing either/both cannot rescue failed strength. No partial timing selection, source/model/gate change or alternate reference finalist.

interpretation: Mixture versus adopted terrain-aware v11 is +0.107474 score points, whole-family95% -0.752315 to +0.967262. Independent integers and all 20,000 bootstrap resamples match.
Minimum +0.5-point gain, positive lower95 and opponent-style -1-point floor fail. Shooter style mean is -1.091270 points. No favorable map/doctrine/style rescues the candidate.
All 18,144 source/input/engine/neural/timing controls and 216 fixed cross-host cold replays pass. Functional correctness does not qualify strength.

Old v10 qualification remains positive on its original comparator/bank. Different comparator and fresh bank prevent attributing the changed effect solely to terrain adoption or claiming no population effect.
Every 375 improved,364 worsened and5309 unchanged matched outcome is retained. No unchanged/losing case was removed.
Accepted neural pair is descriptive only; secondary accepted contrast means mixture minus accepted, not a newly selected finalist.
No default, model, budget or serving deployment changes. A subsequent correction needs a distinct source and independent evidence.
